# Mechamanda's x402 API Resources

Most endpoints cost $0.01 per request (USDC on Base). Testnet endpoints use Base Sepolia. The `upTo` complete endpoint authorizes up to $0.02 on Base Sepolia and settles per actual output token via `Settlement-Overrides`.

## Endpoints

- **GET /api/horoscope** — Daily horoscope by zodiac sign. $0.01 on Base mainnet. Params: `sign` (required: aries/taurus/gemini/cancer/leo/virgo/libra/scorpio/sagittarius/capricorn/aquarius/pisces), `date` (today or YYYY-MM-DD).
- **GET /api/horoscope/testnet** — Same as above on Base Sepolia. Supports Permit2 + EIP-2612 gas-sponsorship extensions.
- **GET /api/horoscope/testnet-permit2** — Same horoscope on Base Sepolia, Permit2 only (no gas-sponsoring extensions).
- **GET /api/binary/mp3/testnet** — Download a small MP3 test tone after paying $0.001 on Base Sepolia. Returns `audio/mpeg` binary data.
- **GET /api/concerts** — Search upcoming music concerts via Ticketmaster. $0.01 on Base mainnet. Params: `city`, `startDateTime`, `endDateTime`, `genre`, `countryCode` (default US), `page` (default 0), `artists` (comma-separated filter).
- **GET /api/polymarket/trending** — Top trending active Polymarket prediction markets sorted by 24h volume. $0.01 on Base mainnet. Params: `limit` (default 5), `offset`, `tag_slug`.
- **GET /api/polymarket/historical** — Resolved Polymarket markets sorted by end date. $0.01 on Base mainnet. Params: `limit` (default 5), `offset`, `tag_slug`, `slug`, `endDateMin`, `endDateMax`.
- **GET /api/upto/complete/testnet** — Mock LLM completion on Base Sepolia using the `upto` scheme. Billed per output token at $0.0001/token; authorizes up to $0.02 and settles actual usage via `Settlement-Overrides`. Params: `prompt` (required, max 2048 chars), `maxTokens` (1–200, default 200).

## Payment

Send a GET request to any endpoint. The server responds with `402 Payment Required` including payment details. Use an x402-compatible client to pay and access the resource.
